lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: apane gur oopar kurabaan ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kirapaal pooran prabh daate jee hoe miharavaan || rahaau ||
lines.translation: God, the Great Giver, the Perfect One, has become merciful to me, and now, all are kind to me. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jan saranaaee ||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin pooran paij rakhaaee ||
lines.translation: He has perfectly preserved his honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagale dookh mitaaee ||
lines.translation: All suffering has been dispelled.

lines.transliteration: sukh bhu(n)chahu mere bhaaee ||2||28||92||
lines.translation: So enjoy peace, O my Siblings of Destiny! ||2||28||92||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunahu bina(n)tee thaakur mere jee ja(n)t tere dhaare ||
lines.translation: Hear my prayer, O my Lord and Master; all beings and creatures were created by You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raakh paij naam apune kee karan karaavanahaare ||1||
lines.translation: You preserve the honor of Your Name, O Lord, Cause of causes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh jeeu khasamaanaa kar piaare ||
lines.translation: O Dear God, Beloved, please, make me Your own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰੇ ਭਲੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bure bhale ham thaare || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whether good or bad, I am Yours. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunee pukaar samarath suaamee ba(n)dhan kaat savaare ||
lines.translation: The Almighty Lord and Master heard my prayer; cutting away my bonds, He has adorned me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੯੩॥
lines.transliteration: pahir sirapaau sevak jan mele naanak pragat pahaare ||2||29||93||
lines.translation: He dressed me in robes of honor, and blended His servant with Himself; Nanak is revealed in glory throughout the world. ||2||29||93||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh vas kar deene sevak sabh darabaare ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures are subservient to all those who serve in the Lord's Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apune bhav nidh paar utaare ||1||
lines.translation: Their God made them His own, and carried them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan ke kaaraj sagal savaare ||
lines.translation: He resolves all the affairs of His Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal kripaa nidh pooran khasam hamaare || rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is merciful to the meek, kind and compassionate, the ocean of kindness, my Perfect Lord and Master. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aau baith aadar sabh thaaee oon na katahoo(n) baataa ||
lines.translation: I am asked to come and be seated, everywhere I go, and I lack nothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਦੀਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੯੪॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat sirapaau deeo jan apune prataap naanak prabh jaataa ||2||30||94||
lines.translation: The Lord blesses His humble devotee with robes of honor; O Nanak, the Glory of God is manifest. ||2||30||94||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man raam siu kar preet ||
lines.translation: O mind, love the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sravan gobi(n)d gun sunau ar gaau rasanaa geet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: With your ears, hear the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and with your tongue, sing His song. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਮਾਧੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar saadhasa(n)gat simar maadho hohi patit puneet ||
lines.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate in remembrance on the Lord; even a sinner like yourself will become pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਲੁ ਜਿਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਡੋਲੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaal biaal jiu pario dolai mukh pasaare meet ||1||
lines.translation: Death is on the prowl, with its mouth wide open, friend. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaj kaal phun tohi gras hai samajh raakhau cheet ||
lines.translation: Today or tomorrow, eventually it will seize you; understand this in your consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak raam bhaj lai jaat ausar beet ||2||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord; this opportunity is slipping away! ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee man hee maahi rahee ||
lines.translation: The mind remains in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇਵੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa har bhaje na teerath seve chotee kaal gahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He does not meditate on the Lord, nor does he perform service at sacred shrines, and so death seizes him by the hair. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਰਥ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਧਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: daaraa meet poot rath sa(n)pat dhan pooran sabh mahee ||
lines.translation: Wife, friends, children, carriages, property, total wealth, the entire world

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਏ ਜਾਨਉ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: avar sagal mithiaa e jaanau bhajan raam ko sahee ||1||
lines.translation: - know that all of these things are false. The Lord's meditation alone is true. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਲਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: phirat phirat bahute jug haario maanas deh lahee ||
lines.translation: Wandering, wandering around for so many ages, he has grown weary, and finally, he obtained this human body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਹਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat milan kee bareeaa simarat kahaa nahee ||2||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, this is the opportunity to meet the Lord; why don't you remember Him in meditation? ||2||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਤੈ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re kaun kumat tai leenee ||
lines.translation: O mind, what evil-mindedness have you developed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: par daaraa ni(n)diaa ras rachio raam bhagat nahi keenee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are engrossed in the pleasures of other men's wives, and slander; you have not worshipped the Lord at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਤੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat pa(n)th jaanio tai naahan dhan joran kau dhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You do not know the way to liberation, but you run all around chasing wealth.
